cases.assertion: The disposition inventory exactly covers every supported Authoring 1.7 schema field after declared semantic-child boundaries; new or missing fields fail closed.
Every field key is unique within its semantic unit and has exactly one member of the closed five-class vocabulary.
entity/gap#/context maps to metadata.semantic_extensions with its complete exact string value.
Removing or changing the gap context semantic-extension value is semantic loss even when metadata.source_semantics retains the original source bytes/value.
Moving a field to another runtime source JSON Pointer, root traversal position, candidate filename, or embedded location does not change the stable field key or semantic identity.
Structured extension values preserve JSON type, object members, array order where declared, and nested values without coercion.

Authoring title/status and evidence_expectation kind/description/related_entities map to their exact Normalized Model 2.5 first-class fields; values with first-class destinations are not duplicated in semantic_extensions.
Topology compatibility equality uses type, owner scope when material, resolved endpoint UUIDs, authored semantic properties, and multiplicity; generated IDs and pointers are excluded.
Normative-proposition lifecycle is absent only under the named lifecycle-free rule; an implementation omission of any other field is not declared absence.

schema_version and fixed adr_type discriminators are derivable from the exact selected authoring schema and are deterministic ceremony; authored status, aliases, dates, UUIDs, custom qualification, and relationship meaning are never ceremony.
Embedded semantic children retain their own UUID and field ledger exactly once; parent membership carries child identity/order only and never duplicates the child payload.

Standalone semantic fragments remain native roots and mixed root sets are aggregated without synthetic ADR wrapping. Complete interpretation is conditional on qualified lifecycle provenance where required; missing provenance is Unavailable without invented ownership.
Reordering identity-keyed child collections leaves semantic identity and equality unchanged; multiplicity and duplicate-identity rejection remain governed.
Reordering entity/data_flow#/path changes its ordered semantic value and therefore equality.
Unclassified compatibility endpoint, custom qualification, semantic extension, or unresolved record fails closed rather than yielding equivalent success.
CEC-qualified custom entity/relationship meaning includes exact qualification, UUID identity, custom property values, endpoint identities, and relationship multiplicity.
A detached scope and root locator derive only from the exact basis digest, source_ref UTF-8 digest, and fixed domain constants and cannot be interpreted as a repository path or admission.
AI 1.1 remains independently valid under its original SCF and frozen conformance resource; AI 1.2 does not rewrite historical authority. AI 1.3 also retains the exact AI 1.2 publication unchanged.

SYS-to-COMP composed_of is derived only from physical-system component_topology.components membership: the owning System UUID is from_entity_id, each resolved component_ref UUID is to_entity_id, topology/local handles are never endpoints, the compatibility occurrence remains multiplicity-significant, unresolved references remain explicit without fabricated endpoints, and composed_of remains forward-forbidden.

Every field disposition names a destination catalog entry, closed value semantics, ordering vocabulary, matching-identity catalog entry, and multiplicity policy; unknown catalog references fail closed and rationale prose does not define execution.

System-boundary, data-flow, evidence-expectation, custom entity, and custom relationship source values with Normalized Model 2.5 first-class destinations map there exactly once; data-flow path also carries owner_local_ordered_topology_path semantics.

An unknown authored status or active is rejected by Authoring 1.7; active never inversely authorizes accepted.
Missing declaring lifecycle provenance yields Unavailable while native standalone roots and artifacts remain retained.
A standalone decision has no invented ADR, owner or default lifecycle; incomplete interpretation remains Unavailable.
Duplicate established declaring ownership or canonical identity is independently rejected; no traversal tie break.
Ambiguous or competing declaring ownership cannot produce a qualified inherited lifecycle.
A wrong declaring ADR or child association changes semantic provenance and prevents qualification/equality.
Reference-only ADR or entity dependencies do not define ownership or introduce authored definitions.
Normative propositions remain lifecycle-free and receive no independent applicability, approval, admission or deployment status.
Custom entity qualification and existence_state do not authorize inherited lifecycle.
Relationship instances and owner-local topology values are excluded from regular inherited lifecycle rules.
A missing or incomplete lifecycle carrier cannot stand in for semantic preservation.
A forged carrier assertion is insufficient; verify its owner and literal value independently against sealed sources.
A wrong status schema selector or Authoring resource digest is unavailable authority, not a permitted mapping.
Wrong AI family, version, SCF, ownership resource key, digest or rule ID cannot qualify the carrier.
Missing, extra or changed contextual facts cause whole-ledger semantic mismatch.
Changing declaring identity or stable source-status field identity changes the contextual semantic value.
Changing the qualified governing ownership rule meaning changes contextual semantics; digests do not replace comparison.
Changing accepted to active is semantic mismatch despite retaining an original replay copy.
Runtime source pointer, filename, root position and traversal permutations preserve canonical owner/child identities and contextual keys.
The complete literal lifecycle is compared in its first-class destination once; it is not duplicated into the carrier.
A schema-valid carrier is not proof of qualified ownership or lifecycle correctness.
Mixed independently discoverable violations retain Rejected > Unavailable > Unresolved precedence; unavailable execution is not unresolved reference.
No partially interpreted model is exposed as complete or as Constructed.
The shared-system-descriptor identity rule preserves the established unit and creates no duplicate semantic identity.
All schema references resolve only against the verified closure; missing and escaping references fail closed.
An incomplete, conflicting or unbounded source enum-domain proof blocks publication.
A normalized destination excluding any permitted source value blocks publication; spot checks are insufficient.
AI 1.2 to NM 2.4 accepted-status contradiction is diagnostic historical evidence, never rewritten frozen conformance.
Every one of the 17 ownership selectors is qualified from the exact schema graph; no additional composition binding is authorized.
The separately qualified child lifecycle source is declaring ADR status, not ADC input_contract or runtime implementation state.
Exact Python and Node AI 1.3 discovery selects the same SCF and all manifest resource bytes; missing versions never fall back.
Publication does not change SCS, current pointers, catalog policy, protocol 1.5 or host execution capabilities.
Independent SCF and resource-digest verification rejects tampered, missing, duplicate, extra and misqualified closure members.
Repeated AI-1.3-only generation produces identical bytes and SCF without regenerating historical assets.
Complete typed semantic values, ordering, multiplicity and custom qualifications retain the inherited five-class interpretation.
The exact AI 1.3 instance SCF and ownership-resource digest are supplied only after publication, never embedded recursively in the enclosing closure.
